name: SONEKA
positioning: The integrated solution for Real Estate Asset Management — value, analyze, pilot.
description: SONEKA is a French SaaS platform for real estate asset management that centralizes portfolio, lease, works and disposal data from property-management and accounting systems, then runs a financial calculation engine to produce cash-flow forecasts, KPIs and covenant monitoring at the lease, property, portfolio or fund/SPV level. Founded in 2017, it serves institutional investors, asset managers and SCPIs in France, Germany, Spain and the UK, and was acquired by Orisha Real Estate in June 2026.
real_estate_use: An asset manager preparing a quarterly report pulls building, lease and CAPEX data that would otherwise sit in separate property-management and accounting systems, and SONEKA's calculation engine produces prospective cash flows and covenant checks at the fund level automatically. When updating a business plan after an acquisition or disposal, the team edits it directly in SONEKA rather than rebuilding a spreadsheet model, and exports the result to Power BI or Office for the investment committee.
features: Centralization of building, lease, portfolio and CAPEX data
Integration with property-management and accounting systems
Cash-flow forecasting at lease, property, portfolio and fund/SPV level
Business plan and snapshot creation, versioning and archiving
Data export to Power BI, Office and data lakes

use_cases.job: Consolidate fragmented property, lease and accounting data into one automated reporting view
Update a fund's business plan after an acquisition or disposal without rebuilding a spreadsheet model
